notes.title: Tutorial Update & Save&Load System
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657520/f018b21526a8ddf30d1ee0bd0f94966582d31458.jpg[/img]

Finally the time has come. A tutorial for the game has been added. All who start the game again for the first time must first complete a quest in the tutorial to get into the starting world.

There have been too many bugs mixed in the last update. These will be fixed as soon as possible.

Desert 2 is being revised.

Steam achievements coming soon.

The data is immediately stored locally. Loading & saving system!
Life
Level
Last scene
Seasons in the respective scenes.
These will also be shown in Steam (but this function with Steam still needs to be programmed)
Account Name or Username
How many times a scene has been played
And last but not least, all-time gaming time



Have fun!
Shadowless Games

Update Laser Sword (Light Saber)

As can be seen from the title the weapon laser sword was implemented.

Some small bugs has been removed.

The Weapon Laser Sword has just been added graphically, with the feature it is possible to disable and actived it.

Small adjustments still need to be made.
Such as:
-Laser sword sounds when swinging the sword
-Damage to the environment
-different colors
-The adjustment of the size

An own Play world will be build for it

notes.title: New Update - LaserWorld Light Saber
notes.notes:
New Update - LaserWorld Light Saber

as you can already see from the title. Soon the world will be LaserWorld, which means that in the near future you will swing around with a laser sword (LightSaber) and have a lot of fun.

It will be possible to fend off enemy light attacks and kill opponents like this.

But let us spend the time we (I) work on everything at the same time.

If you have favorites let us know then we will work on it more.
